Parent: #1202. Original milestone 2 only: determine what complete geographic gap candidates represent and supply supported repair prerequisites. This is bounded research, not a geographic edit or region approval.

Scope: **ten complete families /22 whole components /22 current neighboring locations**, all from the consumed Philippines ADM3 source. Retain every member:11 compatible-original-processing land observations,4 partial/unbound-source-fitness land cases,2 mixed-support cases and5 exterior/unclassified cases. Zero numeric-first members; do not sample only the11 compatible observations.

Immutable inputs are the actually merged #1298 routing at `0198938719a5666b6726fb6a1e45779926eefeb2` (95,173 components /15,610 families). Complete family/component/pointset/contact closure was authenticated against every whole routing body and all36 world parts /49,625 locations; contacts are only in full parts18/19. The source is the actually consumed simplified2020 geoBoundaries PHL ADM3,7,071,267 bytes /1,647 complete features, SHA `2ece3d44a5c6a2afb385ffbf3a6b88d83e4d3a3e7eed9a52cb3be1bc59e289fc`, recorded URL `https://github.com/wmgeolab/geoBoundaries/raw/9469f09/releaseData/gbOpen/PHL/ADM3/geoBoundaries-PHL-ADM3_simplified.geojson`. Current metadata instead records the corresponding unsimplified URL; preserve both and their actual consumed/raw/processed distinction. Whole source shape identities match all22 contacts; none of their canonical serialized geometry bodies is byte-identical to the consumed source body. That discrepancy alone establishes no processing cause or ownership.

Acceptance:
1. Retain and authenticate the complete source, all22 original contact features, complete current contact features, all22 whole candidate pointsets and ten complete family memberships. Bind current/source geometries, original IDs, recipes, hierarchy, physical/admin observations and uncertainty. Reject omitted/duplicated/foreign/rebound members and numeric-first insertion.
2. Assess actual source purpose and municipal role, native CRS/axis order, feature identity, source dates, simplified/unsimplified/processed lineage, completeness, geographic/legal applicability and reuse terms. Research applicable primary Philippines administrative/boundary sources and finite hydrography/physical evidence. A name, ADM label, modern replacement or national map does not prove finite ownership or original defect cause.
3. Deliver per-whole-component findings, whole-family reconciliation and concrete supported engineering prerequisites or explicit unresolved dispositions. Preserve water channels, coastlines, date disagreement, source absence and missing/unmeasured support distinctly. Coarse/absent water observations cannot prove dry land; point evidence cannot classify an entire component. Do not repair or suppress gaps by nearest-fill, snapping, rounding, MakeValid or political inference; preserve any unchanged historical operator as labelled reproduction only.
4. Use accepted tools and retained evidence. New extracts/queries consume honestly pinned whole native inputs; preserve affine/global-cell/coverage/cloud/NoData/CRS/source/date/terms. Shared imagery means correlated evidence, not independent sensors. A clipped/API response is not a whole national original. Huge originals can be honestly restoration-only.
5. Freeze actual code/import/runtime/full-input closure before two complete executions of new generated comparisons. Preserve actual outputs, failures/vintages, commands/times/outcomes and meaningful positive/negative omission, identity, geometry, source, affine, coverage and uncertainty controls. Reuse unchanged accepted science; final whole readback is not a third generation.
6. Complete every promised assessment before closing this bounded initial-source job, retaining unresolved cases explicitly where source access is exhausted. Research completion does not authorize repair, certify a region, permit history import or complete parent#1202.
7. Ordinary evidence encoded AND decoded<=33,554,432 bytes/file, aggregate encoded<=268,435,456 bytes and<=512 descriptors. Use existing deterministic gzip/lossless whole-record restoration; preserve required dependencies and original custody. No waiver or generic framework.
8. Fresh shared readiness and canonical own claim before isolated managed sparse author work. Distinct substantive exact-head review, all required checks and ONE normal serialized queue. Actual merged whole-byte/mode readback; reconcile original acceptance/dependents; release own claim and preserve ALL unique ignored bytes/modes/literal symlinks before exact-token own cleanup. No browser/provider/Neon/import/publisher message/deployment.

Ownership: only `research/geography/philippines-ten-gap-family-source-fitness-20261007/`. Existing regional/source jobs#296–301 and all other source/contact work retain their original packets, claims and obligations. Shared product context is not falsely called independent or disjoint; exact family/component scope and owned prefix are disjoint in the complete fresh open issue/PR pagination, and exact candidates/contacts are disjoint from current French#1310, Japanese#1316 and Kazakhstan–Russia#1322 batches. Refresh scope/ownership before claiming.

Raised and independently verified 2026-10-06 (America/Los_Angeles) by post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`.

Affected PR #1113, exact merge `530a1088ddf6a09ec572806854af86ded9c5068e`, closed parent correction #1107; original #919 remains separately Incomplete. This one-PR additive erratum covers two gaps in the same bounded verifier. Preserve completed #1107 history; no source/geography repair is requested.

Evidence inspected: every one of the12 merged files, all48 complete manifest descriptors (37baseline/11output, 77,955,500bytes), original25 subject identities and country partition15FJI/3NCL/6VUT/1SLB, current parent/child contracts and all14 metric JSON pointers. Two actual isolated runs of unchanged `data/regional-review/melanesia-subject-validation-20261006/verify-packet.mjs` reproduced every byte of all3 products in both retained run directories: reproduction30097bytes/SHA256 `7648ffcdc15a7c70b4c516356d4183b5e7c28196dddffaec4950414a93caf13a`; negative2002bytes/`38e41c1d0e88a85850aceff84a963ffd89bf9e1d1df75c8afecdd9c9dfbc8551`; positive214bytes/`7cf8cfae646c942b2dd0ccaaca84fdd502ad2d79ef7fc4161f2d4d593c092dc7`.

1. Historical output preservation is not enforced. `outDir=path.resolve(process.argv[2] ?? ...)`, recursive mkdir and ordinary writeFileSync overwrite existing reproduction.json/negative-controls.json/positive-control.json. README explicitly supplies retained run-one/run-two as destinations. No owned-prefix restriction or exclusive creation guard exists. In private audit-owned scratch only, replace run-one/reproduction.json with a unique sentinel, rerun unchanged generator into that same directory: exit0, sentinel lost, product replaced. Original packets were never targeted or modified. An arbitrary argument could also target the original #919 parent packet and replace its different-schema reproduction.json. Expected: reject existing products and out-of-owned destinations before any writes, preserving every retained original and dated vintage.

2. Three claimed negative tests do not exercise their stated mutation. `runControls(...,liveIssues,...)` receives all five snapshots (#454 and #910–#913). Its incorrect_fiji_child_subset, overlapping_child_subjects and incomplete_child_union pass that whole array to validateChildren, which first requires exactly four child issues. All three actual result messages are `Live child snapshots must contain exactly #910–#913 once each`. They fail at cardinality before parsing any mutated subject subset. A private harness using the unchanged function definitions proves that the clean, unmutated five-issue array yields precisely the same rejection, while the clean four-child array passes. The result does not establish that all11 intended scenarios were tested. The production child validator does use the correct four children; this finding concerns inadequate control evidence, not an observed wrong real roster.

Reproduction: execute the unchanged generator twice into fresh audit-owned scratch destinations with Node24, inspect every control rejection in negative-controls.json, then place a sentinel at scratch reproduction.json and repeat into that existing scratch destination. For the second finding, invoke the actual validateChildren definition with unchanged saved/archived contracts and the five captured snapshots: the clean input already fails with the same message as the last three controls. Never execute these triggers against original packets.

One PR owned only under `research/geography/melanesia-verification-preservation-erratum-2026/`. Closed #1107 and its accepted released inactive claim are the dependency. Keep #454 and #910–#913 unchanged; respect their owners/source investigations. Complete14-page all-state dedup (924non-PR issues), later history of both original packet paths, and all open owned-path declarations found no existing matching repair or overlap.

Success criteria:
- Add a versioned erratum with a bounded owned reproducer. Bind all actually consumed whole inputs/helpers, exact25 subjects, immutable ancestor/native containing-feature identity and actual four child contracts before output. Preserve every #919/#1113 source, script, report, hash, ID and date; no edits outside the new owned directory.
- Use exclusive fresh output vintages under the new owned directory or explicit private scratch. Reject existing output files, destinations outside permitted ownership, symlink/path escapes and partial-write situations before modifying any retained artifact. Execute sentinel/existing-vintage and out-of-owned negative tests without touching historical packets.
- Build child controls from an exact four-child positive fixture. Assert the intended mutation actually changed the relevant contract, and assert the intended rejection stage/reason rather than any exception. Exercise wrong subset, overlap and incomplete union without an unrelated cardinality/title/saved-snapshot mismatch preempting the tested guard. Keep duplicate/missing/unexpected-child and five parent-roster controls meaningful too; preserve actual full failure evidence and accurately describe which invariant rejected each trigger.
- Run two actual isolated full reproductions and compare all whole products with immutable expected values. Retain full runtime/method/input/preservation receipts and explicit intentional metadata differences. Obtain substantive independent exact-head review.
- Carry forward the original5 correction-needed/20 insufficient-evidence rows honestly. This mechanical correction does not authenticate original primary-source/legal/license claims, recompute valid legal boundaries, establish offshore completeness, approve Temotu parent meaning, import data, publish or approve geography.

The Auditor has not implemented a repair. Original #919 source authentication remains a separate audit limit. Corrective PRs require their own future post-merge audit.

Existing #1108 covers Survey of India ABDB access/licensing, not this reproduction defect; preserve its ownership and waits.

Two related defects in `research/geography/shared-seam-ind-pak-20261006/reproduce.py`:

1. `write_json` unconditionally calls `Path.write_bytes` on retained reports. Two isolated complete executions of the unchanged merged code intercepted 47 pre-existing original destinations per run: controls, source crosswalk, original/current feature extracts, complete fragment extracts, envelope readback, comparison and run receipt. All 47 fresh outputs match between independent runs; 46 match historical originals entirely and the run differs only in actual execution commit. This confirms scientific reproduction but also proves the ordinary command overwrites original dated evidence instead of producing exclusive new vintages. `--verify-two-run` also overwrites the original reproduction receipt. Do not execute either command against retained originals.

2. `atlas_index()` consumes mutable working-tree `data/geography/part-11.json`, `part-17.json`, `part-30.json`, `part-31.json`, `part-32.json`. It records their current digests but does not compare them with the immutable baseline claimed by `BASELINE_COMMIT=c603befd3aaf4da90d59b12378e1e0739331efba`. `main` checks dirty state and records current code/index/hierarchy/grid digests; a clean later committed input revision can still be consumed while all exported fields continue naming the old baseline. Logging a changed hash is not rejection. The source-custody metadata and imported helper inputs likewise need whole-byte fixed-vintage bindings where they affect the result.

Independent negative control used the exact unmodified full producer, with audit-only read interception and all writes redirected to private fresh scratch. It translated the valid geometry of only `atlas:local:IND:7132399B1507487316620` by +0.005 degrees longitude in an in-memory copy of `data/geography/part-30.json`, leaving IDs and original files unchanged. The whole part digest changed from `d575442fef21582fe3e262a829059b71c40976e2a0708dcccd451d54c03adb0a` to `f91d1e793699a7313379bd7f428dc6f979d1f04b23370faae65874251623df07`. This subject's source/Atlas symmetric difference changed 5,334,545.84075661→69,229,073.96696404 m², and overlap changed 1,363,454,481.1914194→1,331,507,217.1283116 m². This is a synthetic audit control, never a proposed geometry or a claim that the retained original result used wrong data. Actual original consumed baseline bytes were independently verified unchanged at the affected merge, and its historical numerical result reproduced.

Safe reproduction: inspect the functions and retained outputs; restore complete originals only inside a managed review slot after storage admission; intercept the 47 retained-output writes rather than running against originals. Independently compare consumed parts to actual fixed baseline Git blobs. Apply the single valid in-memory shift above, repeat the unchanged full producer through the same protected adapter, and inspect its claimed baseline, accepted controls and changed outputs. A corrected reproducer must reject that changed input before any scientific output is written, including geometry-control reports. The original fragment-digest, invalid-geometry and identity controls must remain meaningful and pass on the unchanged inputs.

One additive reproduction erratum, at most one focused PR, under the new owned directory only. Exact original 16 subjects and both complete fragment IDs are preserved. Read original packet at immutable #1100 merge and fixed Atlas baseline c603; preserve all old sources, raw byte parts, trials, errors, IDs, dates, component/remnant ledgers and run receipts. Do not edit shared/core data, original packets or #1139 evidence. Use reviewed whole-file immutable source/custody/metadata/Atlas/code/helper pins that guard the actual bytes consumed; validate full original 89,440,398-byte three-layer reassembly against its upstream LFS OIDs without a source-size waiver or reformatted substitute. Preserve 2018/2021/2019 vintages and the documented 6,836/6,822 and 736/735 metadata count mismatches.

Those research unknowns do not prove a territorial defect. #1108's external source terms and #1139's later raster research remain separate. value.body:
First independently raised 2026-10-06 America/Los_Angeles by Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. Affects original research PR #1089 merge `00664f04790641a9e0c0b29535823076ed243b93` and derived follow-up PR #1098 merge `7a80e177a9f3d026dd5bc25405cf893600d79988`. Preserve closed #395, all original results and source/Atlas geometry; no geography approval or source restoration is inferred.

## Independently verified defect

#1089 `assess-members.mjs` assigns `geometry_type` and `component_count` from `row.geometry`, populated by `reproduce-current-lineage.mjs` from Atlas geography parts. Its multipart rationale then says the pinned **source** contains that count. #1098 `reproduce-followup.py` copies those fields into `source_geometry_type`/`source_component_count`, and the README calls its nine retained values “2017 source component counts.” This conflates two actual geometry vintages. Re-running the generators reproduces the misattribution; matching hashes prove derivation, not that the fields describe the original source.

The Auditor joined every199 native Atlas/source subject by exact source shapeID to the retained203-feature original ADM2 extract (SHA-256 `7eb4cba61f0d17bfacb634c08aff3ec4873ece62734d518b51614bf061a5a129`), and compared its actual Polygon/MultiPolygon member counts with the distinct Atlas-derived geometry inventory. Eight differ:

| Subject | Atlas parts | Retained original parts |
| --- | --- | --- |
| gb:RUS:ADM2:50074027B1024572337800 | 2 | 3 |
| gb:RUS:ADM2:50074027B10379539839705 | 12 | 32 |
| gb:RUS:ADM2:50074027B19808785107388 | 1 | 3 |
| gb:RUS:ADM2:50074027B30864735873510 | 6 | 8 |
| gb:RUS:ADM2:50074027B53792659884597 | 3 | 5 |
| gb:RUS:ADM2:50074027B56233113775442 | 6 | 9 |
| gb:RUS:ADM2:50074027B57421544908828 | 45 | 107 |
| gb:RUS:ADM2:50074027B58811812536316 | 1 | 2 |

The six non-Berdsk/non-Cherepanovsky mismatches are in #1098's45-subject roster; its remaining28 native subject counts/types match the retained source. Berdsk (`...19808785107388`,3 original parts versus1 Atlas Polygon) and Cherepanovsky (`...58811812536316`,2 versus1) are instead among #1089's165 “justified for lineage only” rows and absent from #1092's45. Their valid source multipart geometry is not represented in that handoff because category selection used Atlas component counts. This does not prove they are legally incomplete, that components must be restored, or that every source part is valid land; it proves the original-source diagnostic scope and stated count provenance are wrong. The11 ecological portions have separate source lineage and must not be compared as if they were whole native administrative districts.

Reproduce without writes: load immutable #1089 `findings/member-assessments.json` and `sources/geoboundaries-rus-adm2-2017-scoped-original-features.geojson`; select exactly rows with `source_kind == native-adm2`; require199 unique IDs, join each `source_unit_id` to unique `properties.shapeID`, and count `len(geometry.coordinates)` for MultiPolygon or1 for Polygon in the original feature. Compare these counts/types with each assessment's Atlas-derived values. Repeat for #1098's `source_component_count` fields. The table follows this complete join, not a sampling or external current-boundary claim. Both #1098 verifier executions actually matched all original products byte-for-byte and passed existing roster controls; they therefore did not detect this field-provenance error.

## One-PR success criteria

Exactly199 original native subjects and one disjoint new evidence directory. Preserve every original byte, ID, geometry, source date, old assessment and historical limitation. Produce a dated immutable erratum with separate explicitly labeled original-source and Atlas input geometry types/counts for **all199**, the exact whole-file/hash/evaluation-vintage bindings and source-unit crosswalk, a complete discrepancy inventory and explanation of the8 cases including the2 outside the current45 handoff. Do not overwrite old packets or silently reuse old outputs as corrected counts. Quantify geometry processing differences only where the actual method/source evidence supports them; present-day legal/island/component completeness remains unverified.

Run an independently derived exact199 roster/join and meaningful positive mismatch plus missing/duplicate/wrong-count negative controls, actual two-run fresh reproduction and exclusive output-preservation controls. Bind producer/helper/consumed input bytes. Explain how the follow-up uses the corrected diagnostic to select and qualify multipart-review subjects; coordinate any additional current-source work with #1092 without changing that worker's owned scope or forcing Atlas geometry edits. No source count, valid topology or matching source identity establishes current-law completeness, regional approval, import or delivery.

Dependencies/ownership: #395 is closed. #1092 owns current45-member role/legal/component research in `data/regional-review/west-siberia-roles-followup-20261006/`; this new diagnostic owns a disjoint `research/geography/` campaign and supplies evidence to that owner. #1314 owns preservation/transcription in the original parent packet, not this comprehensive cross-vintage diagnostic. Shared #1309 remains with its engineering owner. Full916 open/closed issue pagination and later packet histories found no existing scoped repair for this source-versus-Atlas conflation; historical findings/repairs remain preserved. The full120,489,189-byte national archive and current statutory/official polygons remain unavailable audit limits; these retained-feature comparisons do not substitute for full-source extraction provenance or current legal research.

value.body:
First independently raised 2026-10-06 America/Los_Angeles by Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. PR #1089 merge `00664f04790641a9e0c0b29535823076ed243b93`, head `adc8473114fd38e257849e6fd5203a75ab46fc91`, closed initial research #395. Original evidence directory `data/regional-review/regional-review-626fdf640aab94e2/`; this issue owns only its bounded erratum/adoption. #1092 owns separate current-role/multipart research. #1309 owns shared engineering safeguards.

## Verified defects, evidence and reproduction

All seven documented commands target retained original files through `writeFileSync`/`Path.write_text`; none admits an exclusive fresh whole-run destination or refuses retained-output overwrite. They regenerate source extracts, lineage, assessments, parent/coverage/partition/size results in place. Executing the original README sequence for independent verification can overwrite the archived evidence. Pinned Git Atlas reads in the corrected lineage producer and whole-source/extract hash guards are real safeguards; preserve them. They do not prevent original-output destruction or bind every consumed code/input to a dated new execution.

The Auditor ran unchanged merged lineage, member-assessment, workload-partition and size-screen producers twice with only final writes redirected to isolated scratch. All five distinct resulting original outputs matched their retained whole bytes. All33 changed API/merge identities were verified. The actual negative test passing the retained scoped ADM2 extract to the full-source extractor rejected the wrong whole-source hash before writing. A changed size-screen source byte was independently rejected. Originals stayed unchanged. The two full-country archives were unavailable and their positive extraction/complete national coverage runs were **not** executed; do not turn these negative checks into a full-source claim.

A separate retained-source transcription error is in README's source-register description of `mchs-yamal-current-region.html`: it calls the seven entries “municipal districts”, but the retained page's heading is `Муниципальные округа` (municipal okrugs); the six city entries are under `Городские округа`. The seven names below that heading still include `район`, which does not change the heading's category. This is an exact capture-to-narrative mismatch, not an independent statutory judgment or authorization to re-tier Atlas units. Retained HTML SHA-256 `a73397b83e44731675ce5ddda196f29a752696975840b03524344674c9de22fa` (91,038 bytes). The islands capture is dated contextual evidence, not proof of today's complete municipal geometries. Preserve both exact HTML originals, names and CC BY 4.0 notices.

Reproduce safely: read the exact-merge script write sites and original README; trace their destinations against the committed output paths, rather than allowing them to overwrite originals. Parse the retained MChS HTML text and compare the literal heading/category with the source-register sentence. New whole-run tests must show a retained destination is refused before writes, a required input/code change is rejected, and two fresh complete available runs yield truthful whole-file receipts. Do not bypass source hashes by substituting scoped subsets for full archives.

## One-PR success criteria and limits

Exactly210 original subject IDs, original owned packet only, one focused PR. Preserve all original bytes, IDs, sources, timestamps, claims, results, methods and controls. Add a dated separately owned output vintage/erratum with exclusive whole-run admission, rejecting originals, occupied destinations, symlinks and escaped paths before writing. Bind consumed pinned Atlas inputs, source/extracts and executed producer/helper code to the actual evaluation and execution vintages. Reproduce the available four producers completely twice, record actual positive/wrong-input/occupied-output controls and whole-file results; retain explicit unavailable full-source checks and any precision differences rather than inventing equality or control receipts. Correct the source-category transcription with an exact citation to the retained heading, keeping official-law/current-role verification unresolved. No shared core geography or legal category migration, national-source completeness approval, import, deployment or publication.

Deduplication: complete915 open/closed issue pagination and unchanged later original-packet history found no scoped preservation/transcription repair. Historical preservation issues #1306/#1308/#1311 own different original packets. #1092 owns `data/regional-review/west-siberia-roles-followup-20261006/` and already records current-source/geometry waits after partial #1098; do not expand or consume its budget here. #395 is closed and its original research closure/history remains preserved. Shared #1309 is related, with active ownership; if adopting future shared helpers requires a dependency, coordinate it explicitly before implementation rather than editing shared code from this child. This Auditor acquires no implementation claim and supplies no geographic approval.

value.body:
First independently raised 2026-10-06 America/Los_Angeles by Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. Affects PR #1084 merge `897fdd0fbac0e16e675a56a15883c22f533b51a3`, head `f0645d26621b3487f6fa67320395e5e627537430`, original closed #264. Preserve its closure/history. Existing #1079 owns the separate three-county/Minnesota source and boundary investigation. Shared engineering prevention #1309 owns common safeguards; this child owns adoption in this original packet only.

## Independently verified preservation and input-binding defects

The documented `reproduce.py` command writes directly to retained `geometry-and-membership-results.json` with `Path.write_text`. It offers no exclusive fresh output destination and no refusal to overwrite the original. `build-evidence-quality.py` similarly writes retained provenance, metric-inputs, positive/negative-control and manifest paths. Running the documented commands as an independent check can destroy the original evidence vintage rather than preserve it.

The reproducer reads checkout `data/hierarchy.json` and parts 25–27 directly. It does not compare these consumed bytes with the declared `metric-inputs.json` baseline before computation, and does not verify the consumed shared helper/code bytes. The evidence builder obtains baseline descriptors separately with `git show 8e1162e3e364cebdec700ec796e2730379494922:PATH` and labels result metrics with that commit, regardless of which checkout bytes the result producer actually consumed. Source descriptors are recalculated from present files rather than checked against immutable expected source pins. A structural assertion or recalculated descriptor does not prove a historical baseline was consumed. No allegation that the original author used wrong bytes is made: the Auditor checked that merged Atlas inputs equal the declared baseline.

Evidence: immutable merged scripts, all 37 GitHub changed-file identities (53,560,839 bytes), five baseline-file hashes, declared source/output descriptors, 12 metric bindings, and independently checked 186 unique names/IDs/GEOIDs/parents. The documented final-write path was intercepted in the Auditor's isolated run to protect the original; this is an audit adapter, not a delivered repair. Original result SHA-256 is `6aa450f637b419957d8207967365938ba3d51185afe7f69cc1ee918e82624182`.

Reproduction: inspect the exact merge's two scripts. The final writes target retained originals, without an exclusive destination/admission check. Trace the producer's hierarchy/part reads and the builder's separate `git show` baseline reads: there is no consumed-byte authentication joining them. Do not execute those original writes to demonstrate the defect. In an isolated fresh-vintage test, a changed required input/helper must fail before any output is admitted; a request naming an original output must fail without changing that file.

## Bounded success criteria

One focused PR, exactly the original 186 county subjects, original owned packet only. Preserve every original byte, ID, date, source, output, control and manifest; add a separately dated erratum/vintage rather than regenerate originals. Read immutable evaluation-commit Atlas/helper/code inputs or authenticate every consumed required byte against that vintage, retain full source bindings, and bind new results to the actual execution and evaluation commits. Require an exclusive fresh whole-run output set, reject existing destinations/symlinks/escaped paths before writing, and use real positive/tampered-input/occupied-output controls plus two independent complete runs with whole-file results and runtime provenance. Keep archived results and any precision differences honest; never relabel an old output as a new run or weaken equality silently. Verify all 186 joins, 99 Iowa/87 Minnesota, original 183/3 scope, state findings, and sibling-workload context. A new code erratum must not claim new source/legal truth, statewide completeness, geographic approval, import readiness or delivery.

Dependencies and ownership: #264 is closed; no implementation reservation is acquired by the Auditor. #1079 has a separate owned directory and factual scope; its genuine evidence/gate wait is unchanged. #1309 is a related shared-helper task, not permission to expand this child into shared code. If shared-helper availability is needed during implementation, coordinate an explicit dependency before claiming; never bypass the gate. Complete open/closed issue pagination and later original-packet Git history found no existing scoped repair for these defects. Related historical repairs #1302/#1306/#1308 own other original packets, so this is distinct adoption work.

Limits: these are independently inspected producer/preservation defects. Official Census documentation/authenticity, precise datum sensitivity, water/legal extent and small-fragment meaning are separate audit or #1079 scopes. Count/name/geometry validation is not scientific approval.

Preserve original closed research #396 and earlier #1076; source/legal/current-boundary follow-up #1075 has separate ownership and remains unresolved.

## Verified defect and reproduction

`data/regional-review/regional-review-82307d5498a4432a/reproduction/area_screen.py` directly overwrites three retained original paths with `Path.write_text`: `findings/area-screen.json`, `findings/area-screen-positive-control.json`, and `findings/area-screen-negative-control.json`. It has no exclusive fresh output-vintage destination or refusal to overwrite retained evidence. It also reads a mutable checkout issue snapshot/scoped source without requiring their retained whole-file hash bindings before numerical output; the immutable Atlas part reader is correctly pinned to `7f23b59fe66c0deb57d88115092f2126d6916505` and must remain pinned.

The Auditor actually executed the unchanged script twice in an isolated detached exact-merge slot, redirecting only those final writes into private scratch. All original packet bytes stayed unchanged. Both new outputs were byte-identical to each other. Positive/negative controls reproduced the original bytes. The area output differed from the retained original solely in 73 unrounded ratio fields (largest absolute difference 5.710987238671805e-13); all three-decimal areas, totals, ranks, source/baseline hashes and other fields matched. A normal unguarded run would therefore replace the original historical numerical bytes with a runtime-specific new vintage even while the meaningful approximate findings remain the same.

Original area output SHA256: `4b4f5da815031989464fd5ad4a80172762003c5dddead5c9386f703f2562854a`; independent macOS/Python3.12.14 output SHA256: `3d0b11ebc278870216d76e8b60ca56c1147a1030e23f86666bedd1795ef6e6f0`. This tiny difference is recorded honestly, not alleged to falsify the approximate measurements. The actionable defect is destructive reproduction/provenance preservation, and absent fail-closed source-input binding, not the supported coarse area totals.

Reproduce safely: inspect the three final writes, then execute the original script with output writes redirected to an exclusive temporary vintage inside a managed review slot. Inventory whole original packet hashes before/after. Test a pre-existing output destination and changed/missing source or issue inputs. Never reproduce by actually overwriting original evidence. Preserve runtime-dependent old and new bytes and disclose exact versus numerical comparison coverage.

## Success criteria

- Preserve every original source/result/control and its complete byte hash. Use a fresh exclusive destination beneath a new packet vintage; require destination selection and reject pre-existing paths before writing. Complete validation precedes output installation, and failures leave originals and prior vintages unchanged.
- Bind the exact 34 issue subjects, source extract and immutable Atlas baseline to declared complete original hashes before producing numerical results. Reject changed/missing/duplicate subject records and mismatched source hashes; do not trust newly calculated digests as historical provenance.
- Keep the original spherical approximation and limitations explicit. Record Python/platform/math runtime provenance for each new vintage, reproduce the declared analytic positive and oversized-hole negative controls, and provide meaningful changed-input and output-collision/preservation controls.
- Compare complete outputs honestly: distinguish exact byte match from measured runtime precision differences, rather than silently rewriting originals or introducing a tolerance to bypass unsupported geographical conclusions. The historical SHA above must remain available.
- Add independently reviewed versioned evidence/change/metric accounting for the new reproduction vintage and run normal CI/queue checks. Update reproduction guidance without replacing original legal/source findings.

## Limits, dependencies and ownership

Own only `data/regional-review/regional-review-82307d5498a4432a/` for this area reproduction erratum. The retained scoped source SHA256 is `5f02fac322a423dba305ddb4786a257a20a9b7b6df0aba88000d7315cb421d2b` (771921 bytes). Preserve baseline part20/21 hashes in the scope contract below. #1075 owns a separate current-boundary research packet and its missing legal/source inputs; this issue neither grants geographic approval nor changes that wait. No core geometry/hierarchy, generalization, imports, legal-role assertions, current-boundary/overlap/gap/adjacency certification or deployment.

Deduplication exhausted all 910 open/closed repository issues and checked subsequent original-packet history through current main: #1075 addresses legal boundary/source restoration, not reproduction preservation; no scoped area-preservation repair exists. #1302 addresses a different U.S. island packet. The closed original source/research issue #396 is the dependency; a one-PR code review is sufficient for this bounded source-only preservation task. Shared readiness/ownership review is required before marking ready; no implementation claim is acquired by the Auditor.

value.body:
First independently raised 2026-10-06 America/Los_Angeles by Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. Affects PR #1074 at exact merge `40ca2f5b58df24baf8197f0ef7b95b8862162696`, head `6b15b6d86f9dafbe1de7a51307120a7d577256da`. Parent #404; preserve closed #1061/#405 and their historical source receipts. Related #1302 separately fixes mutable-baseline/output-preservation behavior and owns the original packet; this scientific source-CRS work owns a disjoint new packet.

## Verified finding

The retained NOAA coordinates are described by their source projection files as **NAD83 / GRS1980**, not WGS84. Nevertheless `data/regional-review/umi-island-land-boundaries-20261005/verify.py` takes the raw Shapefile positions, polygonizes them, and directly calls the WGS84 straight-source-edge area/overlay helper; it does not inspect `.prj`, validate a source CRS or select/record a datum transformation. `results.json` and `evidence-quality.json` label the comparison CRS as `EPSG:4326` without a documented conversion or bounded approximation policy. The synthetic 10E/45N Web Mercator control exercises longitude order but does not validate any NOAA source datum.

Direct evidence from the original immutable archives:

- `sources/noaa-ngs/CUSP-Pacific_Islands.zip:Pacific_Islands.prj` is `GCS_North_American_1983`, datum `D_North_American_1983`, spheroid `GRS_1980` (6378137, inverse flattening298.257222101), degrees.
- Each of the four `UM0501.zip`–`UM0504.zip` archives has `softcopyl1.prj`, `softcopyp1.prj` and `projbnd.prj` declaring NAD83/GRS1980, authority `EPSG:4269`, and zero `TOWGS84` coefficients. Those coefficients are retained metadata, not an independently validated claim of identity for a specific realization/epoch.
- The Palmyra UM0501 completion report page1 explicitly says survey data is NAD83 **PACP00** and its field GPS was adjusted to that frame. Page2 lists the 2001-12-15 imagery and official conservative 17.6m compilation accuracy, distinguishing it from the much smaller internal fit. Baker/Howland/Jarvis reports declare NAD83 and 2004/2005 survey imagery; they describe compilation accuracy and unknown water levels. Retained source precision and dates must accompany any comparison.

All 13 `.prj` members across five archives were read. The Auditor also inspected all13 report pages by text extraction and the Palmyra imagery/accuracy table visually. The unchanged original comparator reproduced its complete historical output twice with pinned dependencies (result SHA256 `893bf77dbebb58be2e267847e08b0aea0ee0c82d6d3d1743a6a87298f48768fa`); reproducibility does not establish CRS equivalence. Raw sources and outputs remained unchanged under audit write adapters.

## Why it matters and safe reproduction

A longitude/latitude pair in NAD83 is not automatically certified as a WGS84 coordinate. Metadata/provenance, realization/epoch, applicable operation and available accuracy must be established rather than inferred from similar numbers or a zero parameter block. The currently asserted CRS is unsupported for the NOAA input stage, and no sensitivity analysis establishes how this affects small-island area/overlap metrics or point membership.

Reproduce read-only: verify the pinned archive hashes, inspect the above `.prj` text and report frames, and trace `line_parts` → polygonization → `land_area_m2`/overlay. The comparator never reads those CRS records or records a source-to-target operation. Compare its reported EPSG4326 metadata with the actual source declarations. Do not alter sources or install an assumed identity/ballpark transform as a fix.

This finding does **not** assert a particular displacement, falsify the broad observed outline mismatches, identify missing land or authorize a correction. The retained numerical results remain historical diagnostics under an unverified datum interpretation; source completeness, water/islet membership and actual present-day boundaries remain unresolved.

## Bounded success criteria and ownership

- Produce a whole-file-pinned source CRS/realization/epoch inventory for the CUSP distribution and all four project archives, with exact `.prj`/NOAA report/metadata citations and any contradictions/unknowns. Use a new immutable packet/vintage; retain every source/original result.
- Distinguish authoritative source declaration from any proposed computational target. Explain generic NAD83 versus documented PACP00, embedded zero parameters, and source/Atlas frame compatibility. Record the actual PROJ/database version, candidate operation/area/accuracy and grid availability where used. Unsupported or ballpark operations remain explicitly limited or rejected.
- Either substantiate a suitable source-to-target method, or accurately label retained-CRS/approximate diagnostics with unresolved frame assumptions. Never relabel raw coordinates as proven WGS84 solely because a standard helper accepts them.
- Assess numerical sensitivity for all four exact subjects: source/Atlas areas and overlaps, coastline-derived components, and Palmyra point-membership diagnostics. Use meaningful datum/axis/changed-or-missing-CRS negative controls, original-byte preservation, deterministic fresh outputs and source-precision-aware interpretation. Do not use ad hoc tolerances, snapping, MakeValid or ownership fill to bypass source uncertainty.
- Separate what is robust under the supported method from what remains unknown. A documented unavailable realization/operation may justify a bounded source-input wait; it does not justify geographic completion or production acceptance. Any later integration/correction must be separately scoped and source-authorized.
- Obtain independent exact-head geometry/source review, complete versioned evidence checks and normal CI/queue validation.

Own only `data/regional-review/umi-shoreline-crs-1074-20261006/`. Read the original #1074 source packet and core pins as immutable inputs; do not edit its comparator, original sources, hierarchy/geometry/grid/releases or shared helpers. #1302 owns the original reproduction erratum and is disjoint; neither issue requires claiming the other's work. No new factual boundary edit, U.S./Kiribati ownership change, current islet/cay roster approval, import, deployment or provider operation.

Deduplication: complete open/closed issue pagination found no NOAA/UMI-scoped datum follow-up. #1294 concerns a different French Polynesia/RGPF source and owned packet; it is an analogous provenance finding, not a repair of these NOAA inputs. Closed #1061 supplies the retained sources; this child initially awaits shared readiness/overlap review. The complete current-land/Palmyra roster/FWS restoration-only uncertainties remain separate and are not silently completed by this datum investigation.

First independently raised: 2026-10-06 America/Los_Angeles by post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. Affects [PR #1074](https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/pull/1074), exact merge `40ca2f5b58df24baf8197f0ef7b95b8862162696`, head `6b15b6d86f9dafbe1de7a51307120a7d577256da`. Parent #404; original source review #1061 and predecessor #405 remain closed with their history intact. This is one bounded geography evidence-reproduction erratum, not a boundary correction or renewed source-research campaign.

## Verified defects

1. `verify.py:inspect_atlas()` reads `data/geography/part-28.json` and `data/hierarchy.json` from the mutable checkout. It neither reads the immutable Git baseline nor verifies their declared whole-file hashes before calculation. The output always labels `baseline_commit` as `f1a6c0abc29de7bf7b7a081a8a9864b0450c0427`. `references.md` instead asserts immutable reads from `947b991690a5720b48b9a664b34cba3f5e4a515d`; both the immutable-read claim and the stale vintage need accurate reconciliation. The three declared pins actually agree at the intended f1a6c0a baseline, so this does not invalidate the retained historical numeric result by itself.
2. `verify.py` writes directly to retained `results.json` and `validation/{positive-control,negative-control}.json`; `verify_twice.py` invokes it twice and replaces retained `validation/reproducibility.json`. There is no exclusive fresh-vintage admission or protection against replacing historical evidence after source/input drift. Two identical runs only demonstrate repeatability of the inputs used; they do not establish the labeled baseline or preservation.

## Inspected evidence and actual reproduction

After storage/safety admission, the Auditor executed both unchanged producers in an isolated exact-merge review slot. Final writes and the wrapper's child execution/readback were intercepted solely to owned audit scratch, preserving every original file. The three baseline whole-file pins were verified against actual immutable Git bytes and the slot files before the positive runs. With the pinned Python 3.12.14/numpy2.3.5/pyproj3.7.2/PyShp2.3.1/Shapely2.1.2 toolchain, the two entire result files and all positive/negative/reproducibility receipts equal the retained originals. Original result SHA256 is `893bf77dbebb58be2e267847e08b0aea0ee0c82d6d3d1743a6a87298f48768fa`.

Negative control: the read adapter translates only `UMI-5172` Howland's baseline geometry +0.01 degree longitude in memory, leaving subject IDs, U.S. owner and parents intact. The unchanged comparator succeeds and still reports the f1a6c0a baseline. Its reported Atlas bounds change from `[-176.6405,0.7902,-176.6361,0.8034]` to `[-176.6305,0.7902,-176.6261,0.8034]`; the full result hash becomes `990c0c0dbcfff35bb748866d2bee370b418289814f4535f07f4c309c4bda73d0`. The adapter records the same retained output paths as targets. No original geometry/source/output was altered during this experiment. Thus stale input is accepted as a different old immutable baseline, and a normal unisolated rerun would replace the historical receipts.

Reproduce safely in a managed detached review slot: verify the exact baseline inputs; execute the unchanged comparator twice with final writes directed to private scratch; then provide the one translated Howland geometry via a private read adapter and compare the reported baseline/bounds/result hashes. Do not overwrite the retained packet to demonstrate this defect.

## Bounded success criteria

- Use the shared immutable-baseline helper or equivalently reviewed exact-commit/whole-file validation for every original Atlas and source input used by the computation. Report the actual evaluation vintage; do not call mutable checkout data immutable.
- Test geometry, hierarchy and source drift, missing inputs, and wrong commit/hash pins. They must be rejected before writing output. Read from the pinned original or fail closed, rather than relabeling changed bytes as f1a6c0a.
- Emit results and control/reproducibility receipts only into an explicitly owned, bounded, exclusive new vintage. Existing destinations and symlink/path escapes must fail without replacing original evidence. Keep every retained result/control/archive/metadata/source byte intact.
- Two fresh runs using the correct immutable inputs must reproduce the historical mathematical result, with any runtime/provenance additions accurately recorded separately. Include meaningful positive/negative controls, exact original/source/helper hashes, changed-file accounting and result bindings in a new versioned erratum manifest.
- Correct the two documentation vintages/read-method claims without rewriting historical source dates or claiming newer factual authority. Obtain an exact-head independent review and required CI/queue checks.

Only the declared evidence packet and its scoped reproducer/docs/new erratum vintage are owned. No shared helper edits, core geography/hierarchy/grid/release changes, U.S./Kiribati parent edits, production operations, import or geography approval. Preserve the existing NOAA historic/incomplete-shoreline, blank Palmyra source-ID, missing complete islet/lagoon roster, FWS restoration-only and OSM query-provenance limitations. This fix requires the already retained inputs; it does not require obtaining new official coastline data or closing factual uncertainty.

Deduplication/readiness review: complete authenticated open/closed issue pagination covered 908 issues (nine pages of100 and one of8). #624 is a general tooling umbrella; older closed provenance/preservation repairs concern other packets. No scoped correction for this packet was found. #1061 is closed and its canonical author claim was released; #404 is an unclaimable umbrella. No open geography contract in that inventory owns this packet prefix. Initially unready pending the shared fresh read-only contract/dependency/ownership review; the Auditor does not claim implementation.

## Defect and independently inspected evidence

The original verifier scans only 34 numbered geography shards and 49,589 stored representative points. Its README/PR describe only Henderson within 2,500 km of the declared decree coordinate, using that scan to characterize neighboring territorial granularity. But the pinned whole world index includes 36 geography files and 49,625 unique features. Two indexed supplemental files are outside the scan; 33 indexed features lack the stored metadata point. These exclusions must be explicit and cannot establish an exhaustive nearby-feature screen.

I independently read all 36 indexed inputs at baseline `249e396178cfc160fd547ec4487c5d94832fc9af`, counted every unique ID, and inspected the omitted supplemental geometry. Ducie and Pitcairn provide concrete land-interior witnesses within that radius:

- Ducie: `atlas:macro-coverage:location:db077050d5ed3c720982`, source identity `osm:named-land:pitcairn-archipelago-ducie`; derived covered interior point `[-124.79586934504032, -24.67817805]`; WGS84 inverse-geodesic distance 1960492.739039483 m; stored point absent.
- Pitcairn: `atlas:macro-coverage:location:749f2fc5f82ad9366ce0`, source identity `osm:named-land:pitcairn-archipelago-pitcairn`; derived covered interior point `[-130.10601424209062, -25.06963785]`; WGS84 inverse-geodesic distance 2482835.2779529756 m; stored point absent.

Both retain parent `framework:province:pitcairn-islands:d483df587794` and valid MultiPolygon geometry in `data/geography/source-restoration-additions.json`. This is evidence of an incomplete neighbor/granularity screen. It does not dispute the numbered-shard distances or turn derived points into original stored points. Ducie’s witness is closer than the reported Henderson point (2,317,660.720 m); Pitcairn’s witness is inside the 2,500,000 m radius.

## Actual reproduction and cause

1. Run the unchanged original verifier with `--output-dir` pointing to owned scratch, pinned Python 3.12.14/NumPy 2.3.5/Shapely 2.1.2/pyproj 3.7.2 and the repository helper. Two actual full runs reproduce all eleven generated files exactly; the retained neighbor output SHA-256 is `920e391b9ffea6551e9f60267a407af5c9ccff720b7f5e69d02d787708e17561`. Reproducibility does not make the incomplete scan exhaustive.
2. Read every path in `data/world-index.json`, parse every feature and its actual `metadata.representative_point`, and report files/features with and without that field. The original regex `part-\d+\.json` excludes both indexed supplemental files entirely.
3. For the two exact supplemental subjects above, parse their retained geometries, derive a GEOS interior point, assert their own geometry covers it, then independently compute `pyproj.Geod(ellps='WGS84').inv` from `(-105.3652777778,-26.4713888889)`. The observed coordinates/distances above result. Label these as new geometry witnesses, not stored Atlas representative points, legal boundary distances or adjacency.

## Bounded success criteria

- Add one superseding correction packet only in the declared new directory, preserving all original #1065 sources, outputs, controls, hashes and the closed #1052 history. Link the correction to the original PR/issue handoff.
- Bind the original merge and exact complete index, every indexed geography file, helper/source descriptors and relevant parent context. Reconcile original 49,589-point results with the complete 49,625-feature inventory and all missing-point exclusions. Do not silently skip indexed files or synthesize stored points in the Atlas.
- Reconcile both exact existing neighboring IDs. Use a documented, independently reviewed method for any derived screening witnesses; explicitly separate stored-point results, geometry witnesses, exclusions and unverified geographic meaning. Correct the sole-neighbor/sparse-granularity handoff without altering the source-supported component proposal’s legal acceptance.
- Positive controls detect both omitted indexed subjects. Actual negative controls reject missing/duplicate indexed inputs, fabricated/replaced IDs and invalid/missing point data without claiming complete successful coverage. Reproduce valid outputs twice, bind all figures to actual full-file descriptors and obtain an independent exact-head review through the normal queue.
- Preserve the target ID/parent, all original geometries, existing neighboring IDs, historical claims and release pins. No official-source acquisition, geometry implementation, new location IDs, core data edits, publication, imports or geographic approval. Legal text, the complete 171,783,952-byte nationwide source and unretained DPA archives remain explicit original-source verification limits.

## Deduplication and readiness

Complete open/closed issue pagination found no issue for this #1065 screen. #1228 covers the different Cook Islands #1064 screening packet and keeps its own directory/subjects; it must not be expanded or duplicated. #772 keeps the older South-Central Pacific report correction. This task reads only retained inputs; no dependency on new scientific/production approval is required. Created blocked until shared complete readiness/overlap/ownership review; its one-PR allowance is separate from the closed original issue and does not reopen it.

Whole-file input bindings; the eventual manifest must declare actual descriptors and baseline.pin_files, including all additional indexed files:

value.body:
Parent #1202. Bounded source-evidence review for the complete Namibia–Angola family `gap-source-batch:3998e6ad8c18d04c89976a1c`: all 21 original components and all 10 contacts across `[18.42566188925082, -18.0421, 20.943746679773703, -17.399540716612382]`. Current best measured-impact rank is 2386; consumed products are `gb:NAM:ADM2` (reference year 2007) and `gb:AGO:ADM2` (reference year 2018). No witness-only narrowing.

This is a source-only investigation. It must not change geometry, repair topology, assign territory, publish administrative crosswalks, or claim a legal boundary/water answer from generalized context. Source mismatch, historical water/ice, processing cause, and international boundary authority must be classified separately; unknown remains unknown.

## Existing scope coordination

- #411 is an open blocked regional batch whose bounded PRs have been consumed; keep this family separate from that broader batch.
- #435 is closed after its prior work; it is not an active owner for this family.
- #963 is open/ready for current lawful Namibia administrative boundaries and Caprivi identity. This issue does not duplicate its 111-subject assignment/identity research or decide Namibia’s current lawful boundary.
- #1046 is open/blocked for the Angola 2018-to-2024 municipal crosswalk. This issue does not reproduce that crosswalk or assign current province identities.
- No indexed exact duplicate for this family ID or first component ID was found in the live issue search. Coordinate any evidence that overlaps these claims and preserve their original scope.

Dated official leads verified for follow-up include MAWLR’s approved Water Basin Map 2008.pdf (PDF metadata created 2008-12-19; modified 2017-02-10), its IWRM plan (PDF metadata created 2010-12-06), an official MINEA 2014 communiqué stating the Cubango basin plan was then in conclusion, and National Archives of Namibia finding aid 2/31 item 3/21/4 for the Angola Boundary Delimitation and Kunene Water Commission (1926–1927), with adjacent Angola–Ovamboland boundary records (1920–1922). These are dated primary/reference leads, not yet retained full map/record bodies or verified gap-scale authority. Acquire and inspect the dated documents/maps, verify actual extent and source status, and retain whole bytes plus receipts. Basin plans do not establish exact river/lake edges. The Katwitwi page is borderpost context, not a boundary line. The 2002 Resolution 3/03 transcription concerns maritime delimitation and is outside inland classification.

## Acceptance

1. Reauthenticate both complete consumed simplified products from the accepted whole-source corpus capsules against immutable registry metadata and original source receipts. The pinned gzip capsules decode to the exact 540,573-byte Namibia product (SHA-256 `203efe…`) and 813,152-byte Angola product (SHA-256 `7cf2a4…`); retain their recorded 2007/2018 represented-year claims, consumed URLs and licenses. Keep these inputs distinct from any full/detail/alternate vintage. Preserve complete source bytes and feature order; no clipping, simplification, normalization, snapping, buffering or MakeValid.
2. Bind all 21 complete original component geometries, original fragment bindings, all 10 contact rows, all related contact geometries, and applicable original water/contact diagnostics to pinned immutable source rows. Preserve feature order, source shard/file byte and decoded hashes, canonical feature hashes and geometry hashes. The preparation packet contains all 21 exact original component rows and all ten contact features, each matched to the decoded whole source corpus product with canonical feature and geometry hashes in `input-bindings.json`. The logical `components-v3` shard names are provenance labels only: actual repo pins point to ten deduplicated ordinary `custody-v1/payloads/<sha>.bin` files at the accepted c6 commit. Their encoded and decoded hashes reproduce the original aliases. The 21 whole feature hashes, fragment IDs and unknown IDs also match the immutable successor lineage; none is removed or upserted by the exact successor delta.
3. Compare every complete candidate against both complete consumed source products and any independently retrieved fuller products that are relevant. Retain complete intersections, differences and contact dimensions per component and per subject. Explicitly separate positive-area coverage from line/point contact; invalid, failed, missing or numerically inconsistent operations remain unknown. Never interpret source coverage alone as authority, physical land, boundary location or causation.
4. Retrieve dated official/primary water, river, lake, ice/historic and inland-boundary evidence appropriate to the whole extent. Bind the full files/pages, issuing body, effective/document date, exact coverage, map scale/resolution, license, retrieval receipt and hashes. Resolve gaps at the individual candidate level; state when the evidence cannot resolve one. Keep international legal boundary authority separate from national administrative source fitness.
5. For each candidate, state evidence-supported source geometry classification, water/physical status, authority status, processing-cause status and limitations separately. Do not infer Namibia/Angola assignment from proximity, point-in-polygon probes, current crosswalks, basin affiliation or a single compatible-source witness. If a processing defect is demonstrated, provide exact reproducible cause evidence and identify coordinated follow-up scope without making edits here.
6. Use a committed producer and two independent complete executions with exact input/output hashes and environment/commands. Keep historical previews labeled exploratory. Include meaningful controls for source coverage/difference, missing/invalid inputs, point-only/line-only contacts, water ambiguity and preservation of originals.
7. Submit at most two focused PRs, each within the declared owned path. Include a schema-valid geography evidence manifest with actual immutable pins, all 10 contact subjects, exact outputs/metrics/change receipts, and declared unresolved limitations. Obtain independent exact-head source review, required CI, serialized queue integration and whole-byte/mode readback. Preserve originals and cleanup only the author’s own claim/checkout after successful readback.
8. Keep this issue open unless its exact bounded acceptance is proven complete. Completion does not close #1202, resolve #963/#1046, establish international boundary authority, or authorize production changes.

value.body:
Raised 2026-10-06 (America/Los_Angeles), Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. Affects PR #1165 merge `72029cd16057199be441058c69dd783604541100`, head `c68342b0f6989a8e59187706134c5e1de7eca690`. Original #912 stays open with its exhausted budget and scientific-source waits; do not reserve or expand its original contract.

Two bounded evidence defects:

1. The README, reproduction status and manifest/review limits call registry digest `63e1878b1a484787aafa029e3f2a8cb063d9d720b38e9d17884a999d28cd10f8` a generated unretained importer-cache object whose provenance cannot be reconciled. Independently read the full pinned upstream GitHub tree at geoBoundaries commit `9469f09592ced973a3448cf66b6100b741b64c0d`: its `geoBoundaries-VUT-ADM1_simplified.geojson` LFS object has exactly this SHA and size **133,712**. Retrieved all bytes via GitHub CLI and independently hashed them to the same value. The separate full product has **1,094,439** bytes, SHA `69f44b96d0690310c67a4a430488fb7a02d028bdec8bbc755436cdfb90962c8d`. Both complete payloads contain the exact same six native shapeIDs. Thus distinct full/simplified byte products reconcile the two hashes; an unretained private cache does not prevent establishing the simplified product identity. This does not prove current legal boundaries or justify replacing the screen's full-product geometry.
2. The producer overwrites existing `reproduction.json`; validator runs it twice and overwrites three existing `checks/*.json` receipts. No fresh-output refusal exists. Executed actual validator and its actual two child producers in a managed exact-merge slot with disclosed child/write/read publication boundaries redirecting only attempted bytes into own fresh scratch. Both full reports match retained SHA `66c8a66ee5ed6e5c06468e5d51b4ffc9aa25c533577e57f691402ec99b990a3a`; all three fresh controls match. Boundaries recorded existing original destinations/prior hashes, and original packet remained unchanged. Passing identity/name booleans does not establish preservation. The controls' unchanged numerical result is not alleged wrong.

Success criteria for one additive geography PR:
- Preserve #454/#1165/#912 original packets, codes, sources, outputs, IDs/dates and shared helper bytes; work only under the disjoint owned prefix below. Do not reopen closed #454 or alter #912’s exhausted contract/claim.
- Correct source interpretation in additive dated findings: authenticate complete full and simplified distributions/metadata, actual native IDs, selector transform and immutable origin; distinguish whole-file identity from legal source suitability. Retain prior full-product diagnostics and explain exactly which geometry each screen consumes. Do not silently substitute simplified input into historical output or claim survey/effective-date approval.
- Add documented fully offline, fully pinned fresh-output reproduction for all six original subjects. Reject existing output/control sentinels, traversal and symlink escape before writes; publish exclusively. Bind all actually executed project code and all consumed immutable inputs, including all **36 world-index parts** scanned for uniqueness (203,277,878 bytes), not just the containing part. Preserve full subjects/parents/classifications and all 24 historic metrics. Two complete fresh runs must reproduce original report values and retain meaningful input/code/identity and publication controls with independent exact-head implementation/source/applicable geometry review.
- Complete unique declared objects, consumed world parts and actual three shared modules plus new simplified source and 8 MiB reserve total 223797142 bytes at audit admission, below 256 MiB; largest world part 12,932,167 bytes. Recalculate actual new capsule/control/output bytes, keep 32 MiB object/256 MiB phase/512 descriptor caps, and omit no original. Entire executed scientific helpers match baseline bytes. Existing six raw Atlas/full-source pairs are valid and all 24 screen calculations independently recompute exactly.
- No current Orders, municipality exclusions, island completeness, DLA/DUAP institutional authentication, geography approval, ownership, repair, import, deployment or publisher acceptance is established. Keep all six classifications insufficient-evidence. Those scientific source waits are independent of this provenance/preservation correction.

Complete duplicate/overlap search: 882 open/closed issues (100 x 8 + 82), seven open PRs; no Vanuatu digest/guard correction or later repair covers these findings. value.body:
First independently raised 2026-10-06 (America/Los_Angeles), Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`. Affected PR #1213, merge `31ad959c0c91d4b0495a0de2c79b05f5d6861e11`, head `16da88f64bec322c093775b06bd6964f648ba810`. This is a bounded reproduction-safeguard remainder after closed #1166. Preserve its accepted correction of unsupported EPSG:3035/Hausdorff claims; original #1009 retains its separate Incomplete source/geography audit.

Two concrete safeguard gaps in the new `reproduce-retained-phase.py`:

1. **Unresolved output traversal.** The guard tests lexical `ROOT in output.parents` and string prefix under OWNED, without resolving `..` or rejecting traversal. In an isolated managed review checkout, the unchanged CLI with output `data/regional-review/northern-macedonia-method-995-erratum/../../../auditor-private/traversal-created.json` exits zero and creates `auditor-private/traversal-created.json` outside the owned packet. It emits the complete 21,617-byte historical report (SHA256 `d3d23c61368d3db4fb5acf049cfaff9f3533a1da7c37c5b96d02070d50b3fef3`). Exclusive creation preserves existing files but does not restrict where new files are published. This was tested only against Auditor-owned fresh scratch; no other worker or historical packet was edited.
2. **Imported scientific code not bound to the bytes executed.** The runner verifies immutable Git blobs/hardcoded hashes for `scripts/evidence/geometry.py` and `scripts/ellipsoidal_area.py`, then imports the working-tree scientific helpers via the pinned original reproducer. It verifies the materialized old reproducer but does not verify the complete helper bytes actually imported. Independent complete-code import-boundary fixture: present the entire original 5,264-byte geometry helper with only `return area(canonical_land(geometry))` changed to `return area(canonical_land(geometry)) + 1.0`. Fixture is 5,270 bytes, SHA256 `f03a93d802bd20fcd42949223022f3cc52a3e737129cd7901164e529f85a2c1c`. A `SourceFileLoader.get_code` boundary supplied that full code to the actual module import; the actual unchanged runner and all immutable source/helper/program Git pins otherwise remained unchanged. It succeeds and publishes all 84 pairs, but maximum fraction changes from `8.050588843771585e-12` to `2.871379527479551e-7`, only 69 pairs pass the screen, and output SHA256 becomes `45ba25eda33d326c62090f17644aa8503cfccb95ecfc05489e645385bb5d87e3`. The +1 m² fixture is deliberately synthetic; it demonstrates a missing executed-code guard, not a real observed source error. No original file was modified. The supplied code control changes the runner's expected pin only, so it does not test this imported-helper gap.

Successful controls must be preserved: two actual unaltered fresh CLI outputs match both historical reports exactly; all 30 original pins verify at their real baseline. Full current imported helper bytes match the original pins before/after the audit. Complete input read-boundary wrong bytes reject, actual self-code read-boundary drift rejects before output, and actual CLI existing-output refusal preserves the old report. Original 84 subject IDs, eight parent contexts, nonzero fractions, method/unit/vintage/legal limits remain unchanged. The stored Atlas geometry representation report was separately reproduced byte-identically: all 84 differ and all 84 have fewer vertices; this establishes no distance/legal equivalence.

Success criteria, one additive geography evidence PR:

- Use only the new disjoint owned prefix below; preserve every original #1009/#1213 packet/code/control/source/report/ID/date and shared helper byte. Do not fix by rewriting the historical reproducer or outputs.
- Provide a documented fully offline fresh-output runner that rejects traversal and output escape before creating any directory/file. Resolve and enforce the owned destination, reject unsafe/symlink ancestor redirects, and retain exclusive publication. Demonstrate the exact `..` trigger and a symlink-parent escape are rejected with outside sentinels and historical outputs unchanged.
- Bind every actually executed project program/helper to complete immutable bytes. Verify the actual import/read boundary, or execute only the authenticated immutable code capsule; do not merely hash a different Git blob while importing mutable code. Reject full-code geometry-helper and ellipsoidal-helper drift before result publication, plus wrong runner/input pins. Pin any additionally consumed code honestly.
- Retain two actual safe fresh runs reproducing all 84 historic source comparisons and separate Atlas representation findings; retain meaningful positive and directed rejection controls for both demonstrated gaps and existing-output preservation. Bind complete inputs/outputs/methods/software and actual observations in an honest manifest; obtain distinct exact-head implementation/source and applicable geometry review.
- Keep the dimensionless area-fraction tolerance, longitude-first CRS, no-Hausdorff/distance claim, source/rights/epoch uncertainty and no legal-boundary/parent/regional approval limits explicit. No source restoration, geography/hierarchy changes, import, deployment or publisher acceptance.

Readiness/deduplication: complete authenticated open/closed issue pagination and complete seven-open-PR inventory found no existing issue for these new #1213 guard gaps or competing owner of the new prefix. Closed #1166 owns the preserved preceding packet and its canonical claim is released (`active:false`, `live_work:false`). Existing #1218/#1209 concern different coastal/Croatia packets; preserve those workers/scopes. Dependency #1166 closed. Ready for this one-PR, source-only bounded correction; no implementation reservation taken. Review overlap again at claim time.

Input admission: original 30 immutable inputs total 20,430,279 raw bytes; complete gzip/ZIP decoding adds 11,146,670 bytes (24 ZIP members CRC-valid, 387,976 bytes). All 16 candidate files are complete head/merge-byte verified. Inspected whole phase including these candidate files and 8 MiB reserve is 40,125,932 bytes. Recalculate actual capsule/fixture/output admission without raising 32 MiB object, 256 MiB phase or 512 descriptor caps or omitting originals. Original release-manifest context is read from the declared old baseline; later legitimate current-release advancement is not input drift or a reason to overwrite it.

Limits: current AKN geometry, primary SSO source/workbook/roster authority/vintages and rights remain unverified. This issue addresses preservation/integrity only. Corrective PRs need their own audit; closing this issue does not convert original scientific audits to Good.

value.body:
Raised/recorded: 2026-10-06 (America/Los_Angeles). Parent: #1202; global umbrella #7. Source-only milestone 2 batch, maximum two focused PRs.

Investigate all ten members of `gap-source-batch:ec15f22bb38e67dea2ef867e`, along the Zambia–Zimbabwe boundary, with all four recorded contact subjects. The complete worldwide assessment identifies unassigned native cells with multiple boundary neighbors; it does not prove these candidates are defective land or establish a real-world water verdict. The original consumed simplified products for both countries are retained and whole-file authenticated, making this a source comparison that can proceed without a new download or deployment.

Scope coordination checked 2026-10-06: #412 and #413 completed their broader initial regional source reviews and released claims. #1043 concerns district province-parent/code contradictions; #1048 concerns FEATURE_TY semantics. Both are open and have no recorded claims. This batch preserves those scopes: it investigates exact gap geometry and physical water evidence, does not resolve parent codes or feature-type semantics, and consumes their preserved references without modifying their artifacts. No duplicate gap-specific Zambia–Zimbabwe issue was found by the live issue search.

Acceptance:
- Authenticate all ten complete component geometries, original fragments, complete contacts (including zero-area/point contacts), water diagnostics and native lineage against immutable ordinary-file and whole-feature pins. Do not filter out inconvenient or tiny portions.
- Compare all complete consumed ZMB and ZWE source features necessary to close the neighborhood, not only the four contacts. Store full source-versus-Atlas intersections/differences and country-union comparisons. Distinguish input gaps from input-covered areas missing in Atlas. Do not snap, buffer, simplify, MakeValid, normalize coordinates or use nearest fills to make the comparison pass.
- Distinguish original consumed simplified products from separately advertised full products and current official references. Verify dates, roles, licenses and precision; source reference year 2020 is not a legal effective date.
- Evaluate the preserved independent physical-water diagnostics and relevant authoritative river/lake/boundary references. This vicinity may contain river water; do not infer water merely from blue rendering, administrative exclusions or ecology, or infer land merely from a source polygon overlap. Preserve date/coverage/registration uncertainty.
- Classify each entire component, with explicit uncertain portions: supported source mismatch, supported processing loss, supported physical water, mixed evidence, or unresolved. A source-versus-Atlas difference alone is not proof of which executed processing stage caused it. Current recipes are hypotheses unless original execution/input closure is authenticated.
- For established defects, give engineering the complete coordinated source/neighbor closure, retained original pointsets, supported repair proposal and before/after geography/native/release/crosswalk/content verification requirements. Keep unsupported candidates in the unresolved backlog; do not present an initial all-unknown collection as a completed repair.
- Produce the required trusted evidence manifest, meaningful positive/negative controls and two actual final executions, followed by distinct exact-head substantive review and normal serialized integration. Preserve unique evidence and failed attempts; release only your own exact managed checkout when finished.

Baseline geometry/inventory commit: `79ffb2ed04702e16f009e4675a8d74ef9bd09d4f`. Original recipe/source-metadata comparison vintage: `cea80a8aa1f8a55ccb448a8f2ff71e10c49a26f1`. Preserve those vintages separately.
